runs.label: story
runs.text: tell me a made-up story about a brave cat

turn.reply:
Assalamu alaikum, oh what a brave cat! Here’s a made-up story.

There was a small cat named Noor who lived near a quiet garden. One windy night, Noor heard a tiny bird crying from a low bush, and even though the wind shook the leaves, Noor walked forward very slowly and gently. Noor did not run away, and soon the little bird hopped out and was safe.

Noor sat down with a soft purr, and the moon seemed to smile. That was brave and kind, ma sha Allah.
